brief.headline: Line up a proven second source and push for 10–15% off: Silk Polypack has no public financials and we have two solid alternate converters ready to quote.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut to ₹205–220/kg (10–15% off current levels)
priceAsk.target: Target ₹205–220/kg, matching the bottom of the fair market band
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for pharma sachet laminate sits at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), verdict: market-fair at the top of the band. We have two proven converters — Huhtamaki and UFLEX — ready to quote, plus global players Constantia and Amcor as high-end backups. With no insight into their costs and real competition at hand, we should land in the lower half of that fair range.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Shift from 30 days after receipt to 45 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹320 in cash for us (15 extra days), with no upfront cost

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we can't see how healthy or how tight they are on cash. Our ₹7775 annual spend is very small — unlikely to matter much to them. That means we push mainly on competition: we have Huhtamaki (₹2755.75 Cr revenue, already our supplier) and UFLEX (₹16492.00 Cr, a flexibles giant) as scalable second sources, plus Constantia and Amcor for high-spec work. Without their numbers, our leverage is the credible threat of splitting the business, not squeezing on their balance sheet.

evidence.point: Market asking price for pharma sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg
Verdict on market price: market-fair, top of fair band
Huhtamaki is a listed converter already supplying FDC, revenue ₹2755.75 Cr, health score 58/100
UFLEX is a listed flexibles giant doing both film and conversion, revenue ₹16492.00 Cr
Extending payment terms by 15 days frees up ₹320 in cash for us
Our total annual spend with Silk Polypack is only ₹7775

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — proven and scalable for laminate sachets; revenue ₹2755.75 Cr, health 58/100

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant doing both film substrate and conversion at scale; revenue ₹16492.00 Cr — can second-source the entire category

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter for pharma blister and sachet laminates; strong second-source candidate, revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health 31/100

risks: Silk Polypack shares no financials, so we fly blind on their stability — monitor delivery performance closely and don't go single-source.
Our ₹7775 spend is tiny to them — they may not care much if we walk; the real pressure comes from showing we've already engaged Huhtamaki and UFLEX.

Several film-maker leads (Polyplex, Garware, SRF, Ester, Jindal) are manufacturers of substrate, not finished laminate converters — useful for benchmarking film cost, not as direct alternates for ready sachets.
If we push too hard without a firm second-source RFQ in hand, Silk may call the bluff — get quotes from Huhtamaki and UFLEX before the meeting.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing all our laminate spend and have Huhtamaki and UFLEX quoting as second sources — we'd like to keep you on board, but we need your sharpest price and an extra 15 days on payment to make that work.
